reuse.why: The weekend rule already has a shared definition, getDateWithSkippedWeekend, used by getNextDate, getUpcomingDates and schedule-template, but the daily rule is written as a separate inline loop inside getNextDate instead of extending that definition.

duplication.why: No block is copied; the 'skipWeekend && !noSkipWeekend' condition is repeated in two branches and the loop re-queries occurrences in a way similar to the code above it.

placement.why: The change is in shared/schedules.ts, but in getNextDate rather than in the weekend-adjustment function that every weekend path shares.

scope.why: One function and its tests; nothing unrelated.

maintainability.why: Daily schedules are now skipped by getNextDate but still moved by getUpcomingDates (server/schedules/app.ts) and the budget schedule template, so the same schedule yields different dates depending on the path, and the special case is a frequency branch with its own retry loop and magic bound.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getNextDate in shared/schedules.ts handles daily weekends with its own loop instead of going through getDateWithSkippedWeekend, which the other weekend paths use.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated block; the new loop is new logic, not a reshaped copy.

one_place.where: The rule is added only inside getNextDate; getDateWithSkippedWeekend and its other callers (getUpcomingDates in server/schedules/app.ts, createScheduleList in server/budget/schedule-template.ts) still move daily weekend occurrences.
